brief:
Hamas condemned the U.S. administration's refusal Monday to grant entry visas to a Palestinian delegation traveling to New York to participate in the United Nations General Assembly, Shehab Wire reported. The move marks the second consecutive year Washington has blocked the delegation's attendance at the annual session.

The Palestinian Authority had sought visas for its representatives to attend the General Assembly proceedings.

title: Hamas condemns US visa denial for Palestinian UN delegation
